title: Zip
desc: Connect the numbers in order and fill every square of the grid along the way. The path only runs horizontally and vertically, and never touches a square twice.

blocked.visited: You have already been on this square.
blocked.adjacent: You can only move to a directly adjacent square.
blocked.order: This number is not up yet, {next} comes first.
blocked.finished: You have reached the last number.
